review.notes: Line-level diff of the OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 12 physical PDF pages, plus targeted verification: physical p.9 (Table 2 checkmarks) and p.10 (hyphenated 'no-ticeable') were rendered at 220 dpi and visually verified; reference entries and the p.1 footnote were verified against the PDF text layer. No code fences, no spurious headings, and no footnote droppage beyond the corresponding-author note. Coverage is marked partial because visual render checks were limited to pages 9-10 while the remaining pages rely on the text-layer diff. Figure 7's column labels ('Input Image', 'Qwen-Image-Edit-2509', 'Qwen-Image-Layered') are printed PDF text between the image embeds (verified on the p.9 render), so their presence in the OCR is faithful.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.9 Table 2 prints six checkmark glyphs ✓ in the L/R/M component columns (rows w/o RM: ✓××; w/o M: ✓✓×; full model: ✓✓✓; visually verified at 220 dpi); OCR transcribed them as the square-root sign √.

Physical p.10 prints 'introduces no-\nticeable pixel-level shifts' hyphenated across a line/column break (rendered crop of the continuation column starting 'ticeable pixel-level shifts' visually verified at 220 dpi); OCR kept the broken halves as 'no ticeable'.
